title: Team
description: One file per GitHub team. A team is how access is granted; no repository names an individual. project-infrastructure.md gives the reason: adding a maintainer should be one membership change, not a pull request against every repository.

repositories.description: Repository name to permission. Every name must have a file in repos/.

all_repositories.description: One permission, held on every repository in repos/, including ones added later. GitHub has no blanket grant and the Free plan has nothing at the organisation level, so this is expanded per repository at plan time. `repositories` may still name one to hold it at a different permission.
